tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “What do you have for breakfast?” (Add do yourself.)
B hears the question and builds the answer. A noun needs a word in front: a or an? Use an before a vowel sound: an egg, a flat.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: An – 'egg' starts with a vowel sound.
